headline: Passage Holds Hot as Shelf Erupts Anew
war_summary: Since the early morning edition Stlican Shelf has flared to join Callahan's Passage at the head of the wires. The Shelf records 10 changes in two hours and 51 on the day about Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost, standing at two Warden, five Colonial and two neutral, with 3,238 Colonial and 3,164 Warden casualties on the day. Callahan's Passage remains the busiest sector with 13 changes in two hours and 58 on the day about The Latch and the Crumbling posts, holding nine Warden to one Colonial with 12,349 Colonial and 14,330 Warden casualties on the day. The Weathered Expanse posts three changes in two hours and 47 on the day about Frostmarch, Wightwalk and Crow's Nest at two Warden, six Colonial and one neutral with 9,891 Colonial and 15,558 Warden casualties on the day. Fisherman's Row adds three changes in two hours and 46 on the day about Dankana Post and Eidolo, now wholly Colonial. Nevish Line, Mooring County, Linn Mercy and Marban Hollow have gone quiet in the last two hours though their day books still show considerable casualties.
